articles.summary: The Human Rights Campaign (HRC) Foundation’s 2025 Corporate Equality Index (CEI) is the national benchmark on corporate policies, practices and benefits impacting LGBTQ+ employees. Each year, the CEI is a primary driving force for LGBTQ+ workplace inclusion and provides a valuable and objective score in the adoption of critical measures of an employer’s commitment to […]
articles.title: Adaptive Earns Cornerstone Recognition for LGBTQ+ Workplace Inclusion in HRC’s 2025 Corporate Equality Index
